title: Which chicken ANP32 isoforms support influenza polymerase?
caption: In chicken cells, ANP32A alone is necessary and sufficient — ANP32B is a non-functional paralog (does not rescue in eHAP1 double-KO cells) and ANP32E does not compensate. Triple-KO cells are refractory to infection. Species-matched ANP32A is required in heterologous cells. ANP32A editing (N129I-D130N) gives only partial resistance: compensatory PA-349K + PB2-M631L emerges at high dose.
